chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang vs. the Cavalry: A Brutal Tactical Battle in the Dao-Twisted World
chapter_meta_description: Cornered on the open plains, Li Huowang faces General Peng Longteng and her iron cavalry. A desperate fight of blood, tactics, and sacrifice awaits.
og_description: Li Huowang discovers a new use for his phantom ability as he is hunted by a military genius in a desperate one-man stand.
